verdict.rationale: Raygun is a SaaS monitoring platform with AI features powered by OpenAI and Azure OpenAI, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack contains no statement or setting about whether customer data is used to train AI models. The bring-your-own OpenAI key option and the pre-send sensitive-data filtering are documented, but neither addresses training use, so they cannot be credited here.
